# `spatial_events`

the connected patches of a band's power above its baseline inside the bursts, with place, area and characteristic size, and the band's home map.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run spatial_events --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run spatial_events --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest        # the line's time grid, once; frames are resolved from --band and --frames-per-cycle
nxr-neuro run spatial_baseline --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
nxr-neuro run spatial_threshold --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
nxr-neuro run spatial_events   --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel", "params.inverse.measure": "$method"} | yes |
| `tiles` | selection ladder, manifold kernel.to (the surface's grid (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first)) | yes |
| `glued` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$glued_surface"} (the glued cortex (`nxr-neuro run glue` first): the computational manifold for spatiotemporal patterns) | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid frames ${band} ${frames_per_cycle} per cycle"} (the band's frame grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule frames --band 8-12Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"} | yes |
| `baseline` | statistic mean, where {"name": "$baseline_statistic"} | yes |
| `threshold` | statistic histogram, where {"name": "$threshold_statistic"}, required false | no |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name, or none: found by `method` (the named kernel must also be of that method: --method) |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-12 Hz` | Hz |  | the temporal band as a quantity (the frames and the time grid are resolved from it) |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - |  | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| meyer |
| `spatial_shape` | `--spatial-shape` | `mexhat` | - |  | the spatial level's gain: mexhat \| meyer |
| `spatial_scales` | `--spatial-scales` | `["parts 4", "parts 8", "parts 16", "parts 32", "parts 64", "parts 128", "parts 256"]` | mm |  | the scale space: one hat each, as quantities (parts per hemisphere, a tile diameter in mm, a wavelength in mm or a named scale); must be the baseline's |
| `reference_scale` | `--reference-scale` | `parts 64` | mm |  | the scale whose relative power the patches are cut from (one of spatial_scales) |
| `glued_surface` | `--glued-surface` | none | - |  | the glued cortex made by `run glue`, by name; results are restricted back to the original hemispheres |
| `method` | `--method` | `MNE` | - |  | the kernel's inverse method (its params.inverse.measure) |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's transform: auto \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `modes` | `--modes` | `0` | modes |  | when the eigenmodes are computed: the package's size; 0: the standard 3000, or more when the level needs it |
| `order` | `--order` | `0` | degree |  | chebyshev degree; 0: the smallest of 40 to 5120 within `tolerance` of the band's gain |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `0.01` | fraction |  | the largest difference between the band's gain and the chebyshev series that is accepted |
| `frames_per_cycle` | `--frames-per-cycle` | `36` | frames/cycle |  | the frame density: frames to one cycle of the band's centre (the 10 degree step of phase work); the frame is the dyadic tile nearest it |
| `frames_per_tile` | `--frames-per-tile` | none | frames/tile |  | the frame density per tile of the band instead (a power of two); wins over frames_per_cycle when given |
| `origin` | `--origin` | `start` | - | start, clock, event | the frames' origin as a point: start (the recording's first sample) \| clock \| event (a stored selection's first member) |
| `bursts` | `--bursts` | `global_bursts.bursts_kept.{recording}` | - |  | the spans Selection the run uses, by name |
| `baseline_statistic` | `--baseline-statistic` | `spatial_baseline.baseline.{recording}` | - |  | the stored baseline (`run spatial_baseline`), by name |
| `threshold_statistic` | `--threshold-statistic` | `spatial_threshold.histogram.{recording}` | - |  | the stored distribution of the relative power outside the bursts (`run spatial_threshold`), by name |
| `threshold` | `--threshold` | `percentile` | - |  | percentile (the default: the false-alarm rate, measured) \| ratio (a multiple of the vertex's baseline) |
| `percentile` | `--percentile` | `99.0` | percentile |  | threshold percentile: the relative power's 99th percentile outside the bursts (about 1 % of vertices above it on frames with no event) |
| `ratio` | `--ratio` | `2.0` | ratio |  | threshold ratio: the patches are where the relative power is at least this multiple of the vertex's baseline (about 13.5 % of vertices on noise alone) |
| `min_area` | `--min-area` | `0.0` | mm2 |  | smaller patches are dropped, as an area |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans |
| `block_frames` | `--block-frames` | `256` | frames |  | the frames cut at once by the finder (memory only: the result does not depend on it) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.analytic_frames`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, tiling=grid, within=bursts | band=$band, shape=$shape, frames_per_cycle=$frames_per_cycle, frames_per_tile=$frames_per_tile, origin=$origin | z_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z_frames, kernel=kernel, tiles=tiles, glued=glued | spatial_scales=$spatial_scales, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape | j |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.field_form`](../nodes.md) | x=j | form=power | p |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.relative`](../nodes.md) | x=p, baseline=baseline |  | r |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.at_level`](../nodes.md) | x=r | scale=$reference_scale | r_ref |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.scale`](../nodes.md) | x=p | transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance | sc |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.events.patches`](../nodes.md) | x=r_ref, scale=sc, bursts=bursts, exclude=bad, threshold=threshold | threshold=$threshold, percentile=$percentile, ratio=$ratio, min_area=$min_area, block_frames=$block_frames, bad_segments=$bad_segments | events, frame, burst, centre_vertex, centre, area, diameter_cm, characteristic_level, size_cm, relative_peak, home, summary |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE SPATIAL EVENTS (spec docs/specs/2026-11-14-spatial-events.md, pieces 2-6): localization measured the way bursts measure duration. WHEN stays global (the named bursts); WHERE comes second: inside each burst, the
cortex's band power above each vertex's own baseline, cut into connected patches on the glued cortex, each with a place, an extent and a characteristic size.

THE CHAIN (one linear map before any non-linear step, D106): analytic (Morlet) → frames (the frame tiling, with `within` the named bursts: the good frames are the burst frames and not the bad segments') → apply_kernel
(NO form: the free current as the inverse gives it, no orientation assumed; the hat at each of `levels` on the GLUED surface: one cortex, the bridge filled) → power (|z|² summed over the components) → two branches:
  relative (÷ the stored baseline of `run spatial_baseline`, read by name) → at_level (the reference level) → patches
  scale (the L2-normalised hat power's largest level, at every vertex and frame)                              → patches (read at each patch's centre)
`patches` cuts the relative power at the THRESHOLD with `nxr::select::corePatches`, the vortex cores' finder, and stores. THE THRESHOLD is set by its FALSE-ALARM RATE, measured as the time bursts' threshold is from
the envelope's own distribution: `threshold: percentile` (the default) is the `percentile` (99) of the relative power OUTSIDE the bursts, read BY NAME from the distribution `run spatial_threshold` stored (`threshold_statistic`) and
derived here; its value is in the provenance. `threshold: ratio` (the named option) is `ratio` × the vertex's baseline (a single frame's relative power is about exponential: 2 is exceeded by ~13.5 % of vertices on noise alone).
  - POINT EVENTS (point_events.h): a spans Selection `spatial_events.events.<recording>` of type `patch`, one member per patch whose span is its frame, and per patch as measurements over it: frame, burst (burst_ordinal), centre_vertex,
    centre (centre_x, centre_y, centre_z, m), area (m²), diameter_cm (2√(area/π)), characteristic_level, size_cm (the level's centre wavelength 2π/√λ_c), relative_peak
  - the HOME MAP `spatial_events.home.<recording>`: a statistic [vertex × (frames in a patch, burst frames)] (measure count, method occupancy): the fraction is derived at read
The events are DESCRIPTIONS of where the band is strong inside a burst, not evidence of a local generator (volume conduction and the inverse spread power; the point-source reference and the null are separate measurements).

  nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest        # the line's time grid, once; frames are resolved from --band and --frames-per-cycle
  nxr-neuro run spatial_baseline --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
  nxr-neuro run spatial_threshold --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
  nxr-neuro run spatial_events   --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --bursts '<bursts>' --all
```
